description: Suggest earlier editions of a textbook, which usually cost less used than the newest one. Inputs: query (a title or an ISBN) and two optional values: edition_year, the year of the edition your course asks for, and limit, 1 to 10 suggestions. Without edition_year the newest edition Open Library lists counts as the current one, and an ISBN counts as the current edition when you pass one. Suggestions run from the closest older edition down. Editions only one or two releases back often keep the same chapters, but problem sets get reordered, so check the table of contents against your syllabus. The tool does not know prices. Example prompt: "My course wants the 9th edition of Stewart Calculus. Is there an older edition that would work?"

edition_year.description: Year of the edition your course requires. Leave it out to treat the newest edition found as the current one.

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

query.description: The textbook title or its ISBN.

name: find_older_edition

current_year.description: Year of the edition the suggestions are older than.

newest_year.description: Year of the newest edition Open Library lists.

suggestions.description: Older editions, closest to the current one first.

edition_number.description: Edition number read from the name, when there is one.

url.description: The Open Library page for this edition.

years_older.description: How many years older it is than the current edition.

work_title.description: Title of the book the editions belong to.

title: Find a cheaper older edition
